subject: Renewal: benchmarking + capacity uplift request
messages:
From: Avery Collins <avery.collins@fathomloop.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Ben Park <ben.park@fathomloop.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal: quick benchmarking & capacity question

Connor —

Heads up: renewal conversation coming up end of August and we've been asked internally to run a short bake-off against another vendor. Before we commit to dates, can Redwood outline a brief benchmark window and the capacity profile you'd recommend to validate throughput and latency for our production workload?

For context: ~100M tokens/day steady, spikes up to ~2.5M tokens/hr, typical prompt length 120 tokens. Our priorities are predictable per-token cost and consistent p95 latency under spikes.

Can you send a short test plan + pricing snapshot so our procurement and SRE can sign off? We're aiming to run a trial the week of Aug 24 if possible.

Thanks,
Avery Collins
Head of Platform, FathomLoop
avery.collins@fathomloop.com
(415) 555-0103
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@fathomloop.com>
Date: 2026-08-13T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: quick benchmarking & capacity question

Hi Avery —

Thanks for the context. Attached is a short throughput test plan and a pricing snapshot that maps to the configs I think will matter. Quick summary:
- Recommended baseline: 3-node dedicated pool (A100-equivalent), 48-hour run with mixed synthetic + replayed traffic
- Key measures: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec sustained, cost per 1M tokens at observed rates
- We'll provide a seeded KV-cache run to mirror your production warm-starts

Attachments: throughput-test-plan.pdf, pricing_snapshot.csv

If you can confirm the Aug 24–26 window we’ll reserve the pool and schedule the SE to run the scripts. Happy to jump on a 20-min sync to walk your SREs through the plan.

Cheers,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-14T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal: quick benchmarking & capacity question

FW: Avery's note below — they want a short bake-off the week of Aug 24.

Notes:
- SE (karthik): please review the attached test plan; we need a 3-node config with warm KV cache to mirror production. Confirm whether we can do synthetic + replayed traffic in the same 48-hour window.
- CS (naomi): please be prepared to own the run-day comms and log capture. Procurement will want the pricing snapshot.

I'll ask for a firm slot and try to lock the pool.

--Connor

On 2026-08-12 09:34, Avery Collins wrote:
> Connor —
>
> Heads up: renewal conversation coming up end of August ... (see above)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal: quick benchmarking & capacity question

Connor / Naomi —

I reviewed the plan. A few operational notes and a small ask:

- We'll spin a 3-node dedicated pool (A100-equivalent) with 64GB KV per node. For production-like warm start, bring a prebuilt KV checkpoint — that'll remove cold-start variance.
- Test will include:
  * Synthetic steady-state at requested 100M tokens/day equivalent
  * Two 30-minute spike windows at 2.5M tokens/hr to measure p95 behavior
  * Replay segment (anonymized) for continuity validation
- I attached a run-script.sh (simple runner + perf collector). We should run a dry-run on Aug 23 (low-impact) and full run on Aug 24–25.
- Monitoring: we'll push logs to a shared Drive folder and capture token-level cost breakdown.

Can you confirm availability for the dry-run on Aug 23? If yes I'll reserve compute and prep the script.

Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
(650) 555-0199
From: Avery Collins <avery.collins@fathomloop.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Ben Park <ben.park@fathomloop.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: quick benchmarking & capacity question

Connor —

We can do Aug 23 dry-run and Aug 24–25 full run. One thing to flag: the other vendor has already proposed a re-bid with a 30% sticker discount for 12 months plus a 99.5% SLA for p95. Procurement is pressing us for a comparable commercial concession to avoid switching costs.

Can Redwood match the pricing/term, or can you provide a short-term credit to bridge the renewal window? We need to present a deck to execs by Aug 28.

Avery
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-21T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: FathomLoop renewal / competitor offer (internal)

Team —

Quick decision so we can respond to Avery before their exec package: offer a limited-time retention bridge with the following components:

1) Commercial: 3-month bridge at 25% off list for existing committed capacity (gives procurement near-term cost relief; stands for renewals signed within 90 days)
2) Ops: 1 month of free capacity uplift (we provision an extra node for the first 30 days of renewal) to prove throughput during the spike window
3) SLA: agree to a measurable p95 SLO for the trial window; longer-term SLA to be negotiated at renewal

I've attached counter_offer_terms.docx. This is a one-off save to avoid churn; we position it as a tactical bridge to give us time to prove value in the benchmark. Connor — send this with a supportive note and include the DocuSign link for the 3-month amendment.

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales 
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@fathomloop.com>, Ben Park <ben.park@fathomloop.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-21T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: quick benchmarking & capacity question

Avery —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the heads-up on the competing offer. We want to keep FathomLoop on Redwood and can move quickly. Here's what we propose as a limited-time save while we complete the benchmark:

- Commercial: 3-month bridge at 25% off current committed capacity costs (aimed to match most of the near-term delta you described)
- Capacity: one additional dedicated node at no charge for the first 30 days to validate throughput under spike
- SLA: we will guarantee a measurable p95 SLO during the trial window and provide detailed token-level latency reporting

Next steps:
1) We’ll run the dry-run on Aug 23 and full benchmark Aug 24–25 per Karthik's plan (run artifacts and logs will be captured in the shared Drive).
2) Please review the attached pricing snapshot; if you accept, we can send a short DocuSign amendment this afternoon (link: https://app.docusign.com/templates/FL-2026-0582).
3) HubSpot deal for reference: https://hubspot.com/deals/FL-2026-0582

If that works I’ll send the amendment and lock compute. Looking forward to proving the performance delta.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com
(415) 555-0177
